title: Global sections on the small etale site
statement: For a scheme $T$, the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] has a terminal object $T$. For sheaves of abelian groups on this site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], the global-sections functor $\Gamma(T_{\Et},-)$ is the functor of sections at the terminal object, equivalently the right adjoint of the constant-sheaf functor $E\mapsto\underline E$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf].
